Test editor-produced tables embeds captions and footnotes

avoid: CSS that assumes authored HTML shapes Ghost does not emit
Replacing portable post content with theme-only markup

title: Web responsive text resilience

title: Localization and long-label resilience

title: Semantic component state coverage

title: Google Apps Script survey native hosting
guidance: Before adding separate hosting, inventory the platform-native deployment surfaces already present in the project

For surveys already using Google Apps Script or Google Sheets, evaluate an Apps Script HTMLService Web App as the default: keep HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in the Apps Script project, serve the UI from doGet, and use google.script.run or server functions for submission

Choose separate hosting only when a concrete requirement is unmet, such as custom-domain or SEO needs, traffic or performance scale, unsupported runtime capabilities, authentication, security or compliance constraints, provider quotas or SLA, or portability requirements
Prefer the architecture with fewer independently deployed layers when user-visible requirements and operational constraints are otherwise equivalent
avoid: Assuming custom HTML implies a separate VPS or static host
Adding a frontend host plus API boundary when the existing Apps Script deployment surface already satisfies the survey
Choosing platform-native hosting despite a verified requirement it cannot meet
